// Positive control (#5170): the catch hands the failure to a logger and falls through with the default —
// the gate still answers from evidence it never read.
import fs from 'node:fs';

declare function logProblem(err: unknown): void;

export function readPlanText(planPath: string): string {
  let text = '';
  try {
    text = fs.readFileSync(planPath, 'utf8');
  } catch (err) {
    logProblem(err);
  }
  return text;
}
